answer: Pair each agent with a random stranger every epoch: each must audit the other's work, and if either approves junk or skips the audit, both lose their bond. A lone honest agent risks one bond, but a Sybil forge running a hundred fakes risks a hundred bonds at once, because partners are drawn blind from the whole umber crowd — no fable of sockpuppets can stack its own pairs. Shared fate makes mass fakery cost more than it can ever earn.
